iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: FreeSurfer fsaverage template, mm (surface RAS of fsaverage, whose volumetric frame is FreeSurfer's MNI305 space). Not stated in this deposit; inferred: every contact's x/y/z equals a vertex of the fsaverage pial surface (within 0.001 mm), consistent with FreeSurfer surface-based normalization of subdural contacts. Other deposits from the same group give identical coordinates and call the space MNI305 or fsaverage.
